=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:544-547,1633-1637,2304-2305 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `triage_target_files_guard` runs at line 2305, after the base-branch gate (lines 1599/1617-1804) has already taken the `target_branch_route` bypass at lines 1633-1637. When the guard clears `ROUTING_TARGET_BRANCH` at line 546 on fallback, nothing re-runs or defers the base gate, so the issue is filed on the default branch without the green-base check or the base_failure_tracked dedupe.
  WHY: The fallback fires when the failing test file is on the default branch but not at the PR head. If main is green, a no-op triage issue is filed (the #7020 shape). If main is red and already tracked by an open heal issue, a duplicate issue is filed. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:499-505 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The guard truncates the failing `tests/` paths to 8 (`[ "${#guard_files[@]}" -lt 8 ] || break`) before the local head-existence check. The extractor returns up to `FAILING_TEST_LIMIT = 20` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4200, 4225).
  WHY: Suppose the PR head holds only a failing file at index 8-19 and the default branch holds one of the first 8. The guard then falls back with `target_branch_lacks_files` and clears a valid PR-head route. The cap is only needed for the GraphQL batch, not for the free local `git cat-file` check. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan Phase 2 step 4 (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md lines 216-219): "add a guard after routing sets ROUTING_TARGET_BRANCH="${HEAD_REF}" ... when none exist on HEAD_REF but they exist on the default branch, route to the default branch". Routing to the default branch should behave like an unrouted issue, including the base-branch gate.
  expected_change_site: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, either right after the routing block (around lines 1385-1396) and before the base gate (line 1617), or a re-run of the base gate after the line 2305 call when the guard falls back.
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The only call site is line 2305, which runs after the base gate has already taken the target_branch_route bypass (lines 1633-1637). No hunk re-runs or defers the base gate for a cleared route.
- requirement: "Acceptance: ... Existing tests still pass. Contract tests cover the new behaviour, the `_ENABLED=false` path and the defaults." (linked issue #9733), and "Every Phase 2 acceptance criterion in the plan is met."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py, tests/test_check_failure_triage_target_files_guard.py, scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, and the pre-push test gate result for the PR head.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: CI reports multiple test failures on head a380cc7, including tests/test_check_failure_triage_target_files_guard.py and tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py. The pre-push gate on a380cc7c reports "Failures caused by this change: 6": tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py, tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py, tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py (5 named cases), tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py, tests/test_pr_watch_guard.py and tests/test_review_autofix_provider_outage_contract.py. Every check-run on the head SHA is a cancelled `review / *` job with empty logs. The PR touches no file those contract tests read, so the attribution is either wrong or an unverified interaction.
- requirement: "Existing tests still pass."
  expected_change_site: The Phase 2 test and CI validation for the changed scripts and fragments.
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR's pre-push test gate reports failure, including six failures attributed to this change: agents-fragment contract, files-touched scope guard, GitHub API write guard, orchestrate library, PR-watch guard and review-autofix provider-outage contract.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:line 2305 (`triage_target_files_guard || true`), after the base gate at lines 1617-1804; bypass at 1633-1637; route cleared at line 546 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The base gate skips its green-base check and base_failure_tracked lookup (lines 1755-1790) whenever a Target-branch route exists. When the guard later falls back, the issue is filed unrouted on the default branch, but the base gate never ran for it. The agents.d fragment admits this.
  WHY: The workflow checks out the PR head at inputs.head_sha (check_failure_triage.yml lines 302-312). The fallback fires when a tests/ file is missing at that head but present on main. If main is green, a "verified no-op" default-branch issue is filed (the #7020 shape). If main is red and already tracked, a duplicate issue is filed. Fix: re-run the base gate after fallback, or skip with reason=target_branch_lacks_files_base_unverified.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:lines 499-504 (`guard_files+=("${guard_path}"); [ "${#guard_files[@]}" -lt 8 ] || break`); head check at lines 515-520 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The list is cut to 8 paths before the local head check, but heal-scope failing-tests returns up to FAILING_TEST_LIMIT = 20 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py lines 4200 and 10090-10101).
  WHY: With more than 8 failing files, if the PR head holds only file 9 or later and main holds one of the first 8, the route is dropped wrongly. This contradicts the plan ("when none exist on HEAD_REF"). Fix: run the head check over all 20 paths and apply the 8-path cap only to the GraphQL aliases (~4 lines).
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: Plan Phase 2 step 4 (docs/plans/pipeline-human-wait-elimination-plan.md lines 216-219): "add a guard after routing sets ROUTING_TARGET_BRANCH="${HEAD_REF}" ... when none exist on HEAD_REF but they exist on the default branch, route to the default branch". This should match unrouted behaviour, including the base-branch gate.
  Expected change site: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, after the routing block (around lines 1385-1396) and before the base gate (line 1617), or a base-gate re-run after the line 2305 call on fallback.
  Evidence of absence: The only call site is line 2305, after the base gate has already taken the target_branch_route bypass (lines 1633-1637). No hunk re-runs or defers the base gate.
- Pass-1 ledger items not adopted (3 related items):
  - The tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py claim was dropped. Those cases check .claude settings and templates, which this diff does not touch.
  - The generic contract-test attributions (agents_fragment_contract, files_touched_scope_guard, orchestrate_lib, pr_watch_guard, review_autofix_provider_outage_contract) were dropped. None of their subjects is touched, and the gate's repair turn ended with exit 124.
  - No defect was found in the intake red-main path. PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH is set at intake lines 1341-1345. The budget_decision returns come before red_main at line 6220.
- HARDENING: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, triage_target_files_guard, before the head-commit check (around lines 510-520). Files are checked at HEAD_SHA, but the route targets the HEAD_REF tip. When pr_head_advanced=true (line 2287), the route can be dropped wrongly. Fix: if PR_HEAD_SHA_CURRENT differs from HEAD_SHA, log "routing outcome=keep reason=head_advanced" and return 0 (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: If the actual failing test is among files 9 to 20, the guard may wrongly clear the PR-head route and plan on the default branch.

  WHY: When the guard clears the route, the issue is planned on the default branch without base-run reads, green-base checks or base_failure_tracked checks. This causes duplicate issues or incorrect routing.

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:1633-1637; 2304-2305; fallback at 544-547 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The guard can clear ROUTING_TARGET_BRANCH after the base-branch gate has already skipped its check because the route was set.
  WHY: On fallback, the issue is filed on the default branch without checking whether the failing check passes there or whether an open workflow-heal issue already tracks it. This files no-op issues and can duplicate tracked failures.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:499-505; scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4200-4232 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The guard checks at most eight paths, but the extractor returns up to twenty.
  WHY: If the first eight are absent from the PR head and a later file exists there, the guard can still fall back when one of the first eight exists on the default branch. The fix is then routed away from a PR branch that does contain a failing file.
- TASK_GAP | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  Requirement: "Existing tests still pass."
  Expected change site: The Phase 2 test and CI validation for the changed scripts and fragments.
  Evidence of absence: The pre-push test gate reports failure, including six failures attributed to this change: agents-fragment contract, files-touched scope guard, GitHub API write guard, orchestrate library, PR-watch guard and review-autofix provider-outage contract.
- HARDENING: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:510-516, with the current PR head SHA captured at 1288. The guard checks the failing commit, but the route targets the current branch tip, which can cause an unnecessary fallback. Fix: when the failing SHA differs from PR_HEAD_SHA_CURRENT, keep the route and log that the target-head check was unavailable (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
